unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 木制的, 木头的, 呆板的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There is a lovely wooden bridge across the small river.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：wood (木头) + en (形容词后缀) -> 木制的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 毛, 绒；毛织物
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They use the wool to make clothes.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 羊毛 (wool) 做毛衣最保暖。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 单词, 字；信息；话语；保证 `v.` 措辞, 用词 `int.` (表示同意别人)就是, 说得对
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which words have 'z' or 'l' sounds?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“我的”。我在听写时记住了这个单词(word)，这个满分就是“我的”，谁也抢不走。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 工作, 职业, 职责, 工作成果 `v.` 工作；管理, 经营；从事……工作
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Good work, children!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法 (我渴 - 工作太累了我好渴)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 工人, 人员, 工作者
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Factory workers start work very early every morning.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：work (工作) + er (人) -> 工人。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 世界, 领域, 天下, 社会, 世俗, 地球
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Football is the most popular sport around the world.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：around the world 全世界。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 担心的, 担忧的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Mum looked worried when I came home late after dark.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：be worried about 对……担心。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 担心, 使担心, 使发愁 `n.` 担心, 忧虑, 发愁
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Don't worry, May.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 我（wo）天天让人rry（热泪盈眶）地担心

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 更糟的, 更差的, 更坏的, 更严厉的 `adv.` 更糟, 更糟的是, 更差, 更坏 `n.` 更多的问题, 更坏的消息
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Climate change will be worse.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: bad的比较级，w(坏) + orse -> 变得更糟了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 最差的, 最糟的 `adv.` 最坏, 最严重 `n.` 最坏的部分, 最严重的事 `v.` (在打斗、比赛或辩论中)战胜, 打败
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: That was the worst storm our town had experienced in years.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：bad - worse - worst (坏 - 更坏 - 最坏)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 值得的, 有价值, 值……钱, 有……价值 `n.` 价值, 意义, 作用
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The historical museum is well worth visiting.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：be worth doing 值得做某事。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `modal verb.` 将, 可以, 将会, 应该, 大概, (表示婉转请求)请
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Would you like to be my friend?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“五的”。“想”要买苹果，请给我拿“五的(would)”一斤那种甜的！

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 伤口, 创伤；(心灵上的)伤 `v.` 使(身体)受伤, 伤感情
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The doctor carefully cleaned and bandaged the wound on his knee.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：wash the wound 清洗伤口。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 作家, 作者；撰写人
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The writer writes the passage to tell a touching story.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀记忆: write (写) + -er (人) -> 撰写文章的人就是作者、作家 (writer)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 错误的, 不对的；出错, 搞错；不正常 `adv.` 不对, 不正确, 错误地 `n.` 犯罪, 欺骗, 邪恶, 罪恶 `v.` 不公正对待
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I dialed the wrong telephone number by mistake.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：right vs wrong (正确对错误)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 院子, 花园, 码(长度单位)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Sweep the yard.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：y(牙)+ard(硬) -> 在硬硬的庭院(yard)里刷牙。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `int.` 是的；对
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Yeah. Bamboo is one of the most popular subjects in Chinese paintings.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 是的 (yeah)，我们相识已经有一年 (year) 了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 年, 年度；年级；一年时间
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Now many people do the Terry Fox Run every year.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: y(像树丫)+ear(耳朵)：大树长了一年(year)，树丫像耳朵一样多。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 昨天, 近日, 不久以前 `adv.` 在昨天
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It was Daming's birthday yesterday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 分段记忆：yes (是) + ter (特) + day (天) -> 是特别的一天。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `conj.` 然而, 但是 `adv.` 还, 现在, 更, 迄今为止, 马上
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Well, it's not "grandma clean" yet!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 耶(ye)！特(t)别还没完成。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 酸奶；一份酸奶
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Teng Fei, how about some yogurt?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: yo (哟) + gurt (果特) -> 优格，就是酸奶。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 年轻的, 青年的, 幼小的, 年轻人的 `n.` 年轻人, 青年人；幼崽
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Look at my brother and sister. They're young.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 年轻的 (young) 人充满活力。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 你的, 您的, 你们的；用于书信结尾的签名前
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Yours, Peter
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: your + s，你的东西。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` (`pl.` yourselves) 你自己, 你们自己, 您自己
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Plan for yourself in this new term.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: your（你的）+ self（自己）= 你自己

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 斑马
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A zebra is here.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ze(贼) + bra(音似“不拉”)。这匹斑马脾气很倔，像个“贼”一样死活拉“不拉”走。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 拉链, 拉锁
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Pull up the zipper on your coat before you step outside in the snow.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：zip (拉拉链) + er -> 拉链。
